# Piero Nanni

> Piero Nanni is a full-stack web developer based in London, with 10 years of experience across London and Bologna, specialising in Laravel, React, WordPress and Drupal.

Personal portfolio site of Piero Nanni. It lists work history, 30+ web projects and the technologies used to build them, plus a downloadable CV and a contact form.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.pieronanni.me): Introduction to Piero Nanni, full-stack developer specialising in Laravel and React.
- [About](https://www.pieronanni.me/about): Career timeline with roles, employers and dates across London and Bologna.
- [Projects](https://www.pieronanni.me/projects): Portfolio of 30+ projects grouped by employer, each with the technologies used.
- [Contact](https://www.pieronanni.me/contact): Contact form for work enquiries.

## Resources

- [CV](https://www.pieronanni.me/cv): Current CV, generated as a PDF.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/morphalex90): Open source work, including the source of this site.
- [Sitemap](https://www.pieronanni.me/sitemap.xml): Full list of indexable URLs.
